text: もしも　その　どうぐが　つかえない　ときには　つかえないことを　おしえてくれます。

structure.jp: もしも　その　どうぐが　つかえない　ときには
structure.en: if it is a time when that item can't be used
the fact that it can't be used

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる after a verb says someone does it for you, as a favour. おしえてくれます = 'it tells you, helpfully'.

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb phrase turns it into a thing you can talk about, like 'the fact that'. つかえないこと = 'the fact that it can't be used'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: つかえる is the 'can use' form of つかう, and ない makes it 'cannot'. どうぐが つかえない = 'the item can't be used'.
